title: Repository setup record
purpose: Open the deployment’s repository retention statement.
summary: The deployment's one repository setup record, where an administrator keeps the record-retention statement.

tasks.title: Change the retention statement
steps: Select the repository's name to open its form.

good_to_know: Only a superuser who also holds the admin role can open this list.
There is exactly one record. It cannot be added or deleted here.
A missing record is created with the setup_repository command, not in administration.

sections.title: Access and columns
paragraphs: Requires an active staff superuser who also holds the admin role. This deployment has exactly one repository setup record. These are Django administration tables, not operational grids. The server uses 100 records per page, with numbered page links and a total count. Show all appears when the filtered result count is at most 200 and exceeds one page. There is no Rows per page selector or Columns dialog. Linked sortable headings change order; repeated heading clicks change direction or remove that ordering. The sidebar navigation filter only filters module links, not table records.

items.label: Name
items.description: Configured organization name; opens the retention maintenance form and supports sorting.

items.label: Record retention revision
items.description: Incrementing stored statement revision; supports sorting.

sections.title: Available controls
paragraphs: The list has no record search, sidebar filters, row checkboxes, bulk actions, creation or deletion controls. A missing record must be created by the supported setup_repository command. Breadcrumbs and the navigation sidebar move between permitted maintenance modules.
